plan.summary: FEAT-PROJELER PKT-14 send-execution slice SS-B: persist a project's plain_text CONTENT choice in PROJECT SETTINGS (gallery template OR free text). Migration 059 + Shared DTOs + Outbound repo/service validation + Dashboard settings content picker. Prod-inert (no send dispatch; run consuming these columns lands in SS-A/SS-C).
plan.q_intent: Send-EXECUTION slice: proje config'i gerçek cxapi gönderimine bağla. Q (2026-06-09): içerik proje ayarlarında seçilmeli (şablon VEYA serbest metin); inline send (projede metin kolonu).
plan.interview_notes: Q1=plain_text spine first. Q2=bulk_send_job(project_id) preview→confirm reuse. Q3(custom)=content chosen in project settings, not at send time. Q3-followup=both (gallery template OR free text). Free-text mechanism=project column + inline send (bulk_send_jobs.template_id nullable in SS-A). SS-B = the content-config persistence half.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A plain_text project persists EITHER a gallery template (content_mode=gallery_template + outbound_template_id) OR free text (content_mode=free_text + plain_text_body); exactly one carrier, enforced by DB CHECK + service normalization.
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: Codex CoVe Q1 PASS: chk_project_content_consistency + BuildSendConfig normalization.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The chosen gallery template is authorized server-side (tenant-owned + is_active) on both create and update before the write; a direct API caller cannot persist a foreign/inactive template id.
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: Codex CoVe Q2 PASS: IsOutboundTemplateOwnedActiveAsync invoked via ValidateSendConfigOwnershipAsync before create/update.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Switching template_kind clears the non-applicable carriers (wapcrm_template => content carriers NULL; plain_text => wa fields NULL) so the DB consistency CHECK can never be violated by an UPDATE.
The slice is prod-inert and P0-3 gate-preserving: only persists config, no send dispatch, no allowlist change; existing pre-059 rows validate clean.
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: Codex CoVe Q4 PASS; existing rows content_mode NULL => ELSE branch (both carriers NULL).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Dashboard settings modal lets the operator pick gallery template OR free text for plain_text, re-populates on edit, and mirrors server validation.
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: Codex CQ10 PASS; SPA build PASS (ProjectsPage-3N85xX2G.js).

ProjectContentModes constants + 3 additive nullable fields on Summary/Create/Update
ProjectSendConfigInput 3 fields + typed params + INSERT/UPDATE/SELECT/MapSummary + IsOutboundTemplateOwnedActiveAsync
settings content picker (gallery/free-text toggle, dropdown/textarea, validation, edit re-populate)

verification_questions.question: Does the DB CHECK + BuildSendConfig normalization guarantee exactly one content carrier per content_mode and do pre-059 rows validate clean?
Is the gallery template authorized server-side (tenant-owned + active) on create and update before the write?
Does switching template_kind always clear the non-applicable carriers so the consistency CHECK can never be violated?
Is the slice prod-inert and P0-3 gate-preserving (persist-only, no dispatch, no allowlist change)?

intentional_exclusions: No outbound_templates schema change (Q chose project-column inline send for free text)
No bulk_send_jobs change in this slice (SS-A)

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: Every validation path returns a typed INV-OB-073 with a user-facing message; the only catch (gallery list load) surfaces galleryError, never silent.
